_doc: Travel reel templates. pick.py chooses one at random among those whose scope/setting fit the request (never one of the last 5 used). Fields: scope = what the user named (country | region | city | place); setting = landscape it suits (coast, island, mountain, lake, city, oldtown, nature, desert, snow or any); pattern = beats per shot, cycled; intro.beats = beats before shot 1 (0 = straight in); transitions cycled per cut (cut, whip, zoom, flash, dip, dissolve, circle, rise, blur); whip and rise follow the outgoing shot's move so motion carries across the cut; moves cycled per shot; text = overlay kinds; target = wanted motion (YDIF per 24 fps frame) for the @auto window; music.lyrics uses {place}, sung, original lyrics.

local_sounds._doc: Local instruments keyed by lowercase country/region: the whole style of local-flavour, and added to every other template's music when --country names one of them (fallback 'default', local-flavour only).
local_sounds.japan: Japanese pop, koto melody, shamisen accents, soft taiko
local_sounds.vietnam: V-pop, dan bau melody, modern ballad pop
local_sounds.switzerland: alpine folk pop, yodel hook, accordion
local_sounds.ireland: Irish folk pop, fiddle, tin whistle

lights.sunny: Bright sunny summer day, deep blue sky with a few white clouds, crisp clear air
lights.golden: Late afternoon with the sun still well above the horizon: warm golden light, the whole scene brightly lit, soft shadows with full detail, a light warm sky
lights.sunrise: Shortly after sunrise, the sun already up: soft bright pink-gold light on the landscape, a little morning haze, the scene well lit
lights.morning: Fresh clear morning, soft bright light, pale blue sky
lights.bluehour: Blue hour just after sunset, deep blue sky, warm city lights switching on, reflections
lights.night: Night, city lights glowing, dark blue sky, illuminated landmarks
lights.misty: Early morning mist drifting through valleys, soft diffused light, sun breaking through
lights.overcast: Soft overcast sky, even light, calm muted atmosphere, wet stone streets
lights.snow: Fresh snow everywhere, bright winter sun, crisp blue sky, frosted trees

moves.push-in: slow push-in straight toward the subject
moves.pull-out: slow pull-back away from the subject, revealing more around it
moves.lateral-right: slow lateral glide to the RIGHT, the scene drifts from right to left across the frame
moves.lateral-left: slow lateral glide to the LEFT, the scene drifts from left to right across the frame
moves.orbit-left: slow orbit counter-clockwise around the subject
moves.orbit-right: slow orbit clockwise around the subject
moves.rise: slow vertical rise straight up, revealing what lies behind
moves.reveal: rising over a foreground ridge or trees to reveal the subject
moves.top-down: straight-down bird's-eye view, gliding slowly forward over the scene
moves.fpv: fast smooth FPV drone flight skimming low and banking past the subject

sceneries._doc: Per-setting style mixed into every template by pick.py: the music comes from one of the setting's styles (the template keeps its lyrics), and shots alternate the template's signature move and transition with the setting's own, so reels of different places never look or sound alike (user rule, 2026-10-28).
